title: ClawHub Skills or Custom OpenClaw Skills: When to Install, When to Build
summary: ClawHub has 5,400+ OpenClaw skills. But when should you install one vs write your own? This decision guide covers the exact criteria with security tips and a fast-build template.
body_markdown: Not by default. ClawHub skills are community-contributed code — always read the SKILL.md before installing, test in a sandbox, and avoid skills that request unnecessary permissions. For truly sensitive operations (customer PII, financial data, internal APIs), write a custom skill you control entirely.
